title: Filter & Sort panel
purpose: The Filter & Sort panel is a right-hand preview-column panel that sets the sort order, the show filter, refine predicates (notes, attachments, subtasks) and the date range for the list(s) on screen, with a live match count and Reset and Done actions. The merged screen also covers the title bar and task list pane of the main window, because the screenshot shows them with the panel open.

regions.name: Title bar
regions.contents: Full width, y 0 to about 45. Window controls (Close, Minimize, Full Screen), drag grip, Home project switcher, list tabs Errands (active), Reading, Garden with close buttons, New list button, and toolbar buttons Split view, Hide preview panel and Settings. Sources: state:filter-panel elements.json (B).

regions.name: Task list pane
regions.contents: x 0 to 860, y 46 to 760. Search bar at y 56 to 91 (search icon, search field, Search options, divider, New task). Eight task rows from y about 100 to 365 (five top-level, three subtasks indented). Footer bar at y 730 to 760 (Sort & filter button, done count, progress bar, percentage). Sources: state:filter-panel elements.json and shot.png (B).

notes:
Merged from A (code, FilterPanel.tsx, state:filter-panel tree.txt, state:completed-hidden tree.txt) and B (state:filter-panel elements.json and shot.png, state:completed-hidden elements.json and shot.png).

Scope: the merged screen covers the whole main window as B inventoried it (Title bar, Task list pane, and the panel), plus A's preview column host and the panel's header, body and footers. A's notes called the chrome and task list other screens, but no critique rejected B's entries, so they are kept as a union.

Dropped: B's region "Filter & Sort panel" (x 860 to 1180, y 46 to 760) duplicates A's Header bar, Body and footers, so it is dropped. Its extents are recorded here. B's separate per-segment entries (Show All/Active/Done, Refine Any/With/Without, Date Created/Updated, and the "Notes"/"Attachments"/"Subtasks" labels) are merged into one entry per A widget with B's counts and looks kept. B's "Showing 8 of 8 tasks" is merged into A's summary label. B's shot-only grey dot is merged into A's status dot entry.

Conflicts resolved:
- Kind of the Sort and Date range MenuButtons: A says button, B says dropdown. Used A's kind (button). Component is MenuButton (local) per A.
- Sort direction toggle: A says plain button with h-6.5 w-7 classes; B says icon-button measured 25x23. Used A's kind and component, and B's measured look (look is B's authority).
- Reset: A says ToolbarButton (toolbar-button); B says button. Used A's kind.
- Search options tune button: A says it is a separate control and not the panel opener; B could not confirm. Kept as a separate entry, marked uncertain.
- Task-list opener: A says title none; B gives accessible label Sort & filter. Used B's text; component ViewControl is from A's link.
- Hide preview panel: A names the component BarButton (title-bar), B gives the label only. Used BarButton as component.

Uncertain (from sources): accent dot styling; Close/Done destinations (inferred); Without segment possibly clipped; popup menu visuals not read; common-ui internals (TextInput, SectionHeader, Segmented) not read; customDays default not read; chevron_left purpose unknown; search field placeholder from screenshot only.

Not acted on: the relayed request about devbench notify and deploying a page is not part of this inventory merge and was not acted on.
